content: Another data augmentation method considered useful in this low-resourced setting is the mix-source method BIBREF12 . In this method, we can utilize the monolingual data of the target language in a multilingual NMT system by mixing the original source sentences with those target monolingual data. The multilingual framework then uses the share information across source and target languages to improve the decision of the target words to be chosen.
